name: animal shapes
lore:
### On the Transmutation of Kin: *Animal Shapes*

To cast *Animal Shapes* is to handle the Weave not as a brittle thread, but as warm, living clay. The caster feels a rhythmic thrumming—the very heartbeat of the world—surging through their marrow. It is a heavy, viscous magic that demands the caster’s will to act as a mold for the primal energies being unleashed.

Visually, the transformation is a breathtaking spectacle of "spirit-smoke." Before the physical flesh yields, translucent, spectral silhouettes of great bears, stags, or eagles overlay the subjects. In a flash of emerald radiance, the phantom and the mortal merge; bones lengthen and fur sprouts in a seamless, painless ripple of golden light.

Legend attributes this discovery to the Archdruid Elara. When the Iron Colossus threatened the Whispering Woods, Elara realized her circle lacked the strength of steel. She reached into the "Great Bestiary" of the stars, weaving the constellations into her kin. Within moments, a dozen scholars became a phalanx of mammoths, crushing the invader.

Remember, adventurer: while the mind remains your own, the blood sings with a wilder tune. Do not let the song drown out your purpose.
